narrative_purpose: The chapter's representative cover image: one iconic floating mountain that makes a reader want to open the chapter.
subject: A single enormous island of grey stone floating in open sky. Its sides are sheer vertical cliffs of weathered rock; its flat top is covered in dense blue-green forest. From the underside hang long trailing curtains of vines and dangling roots. Nothing connects it to anything - empty air all around and below it.
scene: High above a flat white cloud deck at dawn. Two or three much smaller floating rock islands sit far in the hazy distance behind the main one. A faint glowing mist, organised into soft curving bands, wreathes the lower rock as if the air itself carries a current.
camera: Wide cinematic establishing shot from slightly below, looking up at the underside and cliff face of the suspended island so it towers over the viewer.
light: Soft warm dawn sunlight striking from the left, rimming the cliff edges; cool blue shadow on the right faces; a gentle glowing fill rising from the mist below.
palette: Deep blue sky shading to near-black at the top, grey rock, blue-green canopy, cyan and teal glow in the mist, a thin band of warm amber dawn light on the horizon.
style: Painterly photorealistic concept art with strong atmospheric depth.
detail_level: Crisp high detail on the near cliff face, vines, and forest edge; soft atmospheric haze fading the distant islands.
composition: The floating island fills the upper two-thirds; the lower third is open sky and cloud to emphasise that nothing holds it up. Island placed on a rule-of-thirds line.
consistency_notes: Grey weathered rock, blue-green canopy on top, cyan-teal glowing mist around the base. This image defines the look every other floating-mountain scene in the chapter must match.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no logos, no humans, no modern machinery, no oversaturation, no cartoon or anime style
